text: Touring the Pacific Northwest, the punk band the Ain't Rights take [a last-minute gig at a neo-Nazi skinhead bar|archetypes|The Bad Host] in the woods outside Portland. Going back to the green room for a phone, Pat [walks in on the body of a stabbed woman|trigger|seeing or hearing too much], and the band are [held captive in the green room|rules|trapped with no way out] with the dead woman's friend Amber. Outside, the bar owner Darcy decides [to kill them and stage their deaths|wants|keeping crimes hidden], sending skinheads with machetes and an attack dog.
